name: aversion to unpopular creatures
quote: Snakes. Why'd it have to be snakes?
description: Anxiety about a type of animal perceived to be dangerous or scary.

variations.name: aversion to crawly creatures
variations.description: Anxiety about a type of animal perceived to be creepy.
examples: Discomfort around bugs, rats, lizards, etc.

variations.name: aversion to dangerous creatures
variations.description: Anxiety about a type of animal perceived to be dangerous.
examples: Fear of snakes, spiders, tigers, etc.

commentaries.quote: Many of us are afraid of those animals that killed and injured our ancient ancestors whether it makes sense in the modern world or not.

conditions: You perceive a type of creature to be dangerous or generally scary.
